subject: ZhiXing 0.42.0 workbench navigation and delivery text preview

lockfileAtInspection.note: Installed lockfile fingerprint at source inspection; provenance only, not the release build identity.

acquisition: Read npm packages restored from this repository lockfile; no fresh extraction of the user Windows Harness installation.

observations.upstream: The delivery card calls openFile. The chat owner resolves a session file address and calls sidebarRight.openResource.
observations.candidateScope: Use the existing host-verified delivery reference to show extracted text in the right-hand deliverables view; no native resource URI or dynamic per-file tab implementation.

observations.upstream: Closing-prose file mentions use the owner openFile entry point.
observations.candidateScope: Retain the existing unambiguous reference matching limited to this message deliveries and route that entry to the same preview.

evidence.section: 呈现形态 / 状态 / ctx.sidebarRight

observations.upstream: The right panel renders a DockLayout with resource tabs and panel controls; the owner also manages session layouts, split panes and floating panels.
observations.candidateScope: Visible navigation for nine existing functional views, not the full native resource-tab or docking model.

observations.upstream: A fallback text tab claims session file addresses and registers a right-panel body with remote file reads.
observations.candidateScope: Extracted local text with coverage and truncation notices; Office extraction is not equivalent to the native Office renderer.

observations.upstream: The preview has loading/failure/retry states and tracks generations, per-tab state and abort signals.
observations.candidateScope: Scope and request generation reject stale renderer results. Existing host read IPC has no cancellation argument, so already-started parsing is not cancelled by dismissing the preview.

observations.upstream: The official plugin separately registers Markdown, HTML, image, PDF, Office, spreadsheet and code renderers. Word and PowerPoint previews use locally converted PDF.
observations.candidateScope: These original-layout and interactive renderers are not implemented by this delivery text-preview change. Existing workspace-file features are a separate authorization and UI path.

observations.upstream: The viewer does not register tools, prompt fragments or session events; viewed content does not enter model requests.
observations.candidateScope: Hold preview content only in transient renderer state. Do not attach it to prompts, documents, drafts or persisted chat history.
